answer_1.quote: For each entry in the dataset, we instruct the models to complete a straightforward task: generating a description for the given entry in each of the three languages... We conduct experiments with essay generation (Firefly composition split) and open-domain QA (OpenLabel-Chinese Conversations).
answer_1.outputs: Generated Wikipedia-style descriptions, essay texts, and open-domain QA answers in English, Chinese, and French.

answer_2.quote: We propose to measure the lexical naturalness of an LLM by comparing the vocabulary distribution of its generated text with that of human-written text... using the Jensen-Shannon Divergence (JSD). For syntactic naturalness we compute the Weisfeiler‑Lehman graph kernel similarity between dependency trees and then apply the Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) to obtain a syntactic divergence score.
